import nanosurf

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
zcontrol = application.ZController

# Set Z controller parameters (PID gains)
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Set scan parameters
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # Time per line in seconds
scan.Lines = 128     # Lines per frame

print(f"PID Gains set to: P={zcontrol.PGain}, I={zcontrol.IGain}, D={zcontrol.DGain}")
print(f"Scan parameters set to: Time per Line={scan.Scantime}s, Lines per Frame={scan.Lines}")

del spm

'''initiate/start or terminate/stop image scanning process'''
import nanosurf
import time

#load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # or .C3000() or .CX(), or .CoreAFM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Start scan
# scan.StartFrameDown() #Scanning from up to down or top to bottom
scan.StartFrameUp() #Scanning from down to up or bottom to top

#scan.stop() #stop sacn
scanning = scan.IsScanning # Check if scanning
while scanning:
        print("Scanning in progress... Remaining lines:",(scan.Lines-scan.Currentline))
        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf
import time

# Initialize SPM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode

# Set scan parameters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128   # lines per frame
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm

# Calculate and set time per line
# Total time should be 51.2s, so time per line = 51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s
scan.TimePerLine = 0.4  # seconds

# Set to dynamic mode (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
opmode.Mode = "Dynamic"

# Start scan (bottom to top)
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan completion
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    time.sleep(1)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scan completed")
del spm
